reason: The cited evidence shows deep learning potentials accurately describe solid and liquid states of high-entropy carbonitrides (E2, E3), supporting the first premise, but provides no direct support for improved phase-space overlap, reduced path mismatch, or applicability to metallic HEAs rather than carbonitrides; E1 and E4 are irrelevant to the methodological claims.
premises: Deep learning potentials can represent atomic configurations of ab initio liquids in high-entropy systems
Improved representation of liquid configurations enhances reference-target phase-space overlap
Better phase-space overlap improves accuracy of predicted thermodynamic properties like melting temperatures
The approach is applicable to high-entropy alloys with multiple principal elements near melting points
The method reduces thermodynamic-integration path mismatch compared to EAM references
